history.summary: A large 1,560 sqft 99-yr-leasehold 3BR (built 1999, ~72yr lease left) at $1.999M / $1,281 PSF in D15, 860m from Siglap MRT (TEL). The low PSF is a function of age and decaying lease, not value — reliable URA data (74 txns) prints just 2.38%/yr appreciation, the weakest in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: 2.38% CAGR on a reliable 74-txn series is well below OCR/RCR baselines and barely tracks inflation — a poor 5-7yr investment. ~72 years of lease remaining means accelerating lease-decay drag and financing limits as it ages. The roomy 1,560 sqft inflates quantum to $2.0M while rent won't scale with size, capping yield (~2.7%). Lowest technical score in batch (381).
